offering_description.value: Verano sells cannabis products to medical patients, adult-use consumers and licensed dispensaries. It grows cannabis, makes finished products and sells them through its own dispensaries and wholesale accounts.

primary_products.value: cannabis flower; pre-rolls; vape cartridges; edibles; concentrates

customer_segment.value: B2C: Medical cannabis patients and adult-use consumers; B2B: Licensed independent dispensaries and cannabis retail chains

revenue_model.value: product sales: Retail cannabis purchases and wholesale orders from licensed dispensaries

value_chain_position.value: retailer: Sells its own and third-party cannabis products to medical patients and adult-use consumers; OEM / manufacturer: Processes harvested cannabis into finished products for its own stores and licensed wholesale customers; raw materials: Grows cannabis for its processing facilities and for sale as flower through licensed dispensaries

geography_served.value: US regional: Selected states across the Midwest, East Coast and Southwest, including Illinois, Florida, New Jersey, Pennsylvania, Arizona and Nevada

specialization.value: related lines: Cannabis cultivation, finished cannabis products and dispensary retail

distribution_channels.value: own locations: Company-operated medical and adult-use dispensaries; direct sales: Wholesale sales to licensed third-party dispensaries; online: Dispensary websites for browsing inventory and placing pickup orders

regulatory_exposure.value: high: State licenses govern cultivation, processing and dispensary sales, and federal controlled-substance rules apply.

notes: The exact current state footprint is uncertain.
